aqua.name: AQuA-RAT five-choice mathematics
aqua.scope: One original mathematics problem and its five original answer options per task. Official test is evaluation; official dev is feasibility.
aqua.metric: Answer accuracy over 254 official test questions.
limits: One field per task provides no cross-field prefix reuse.
Direct answer selection does not evaluate rationale generation; original rationales are excluded from model input.

race_middle.name: RACE-middle reading comprehension
race_middle.scope: All official middle validation articles with every original question preserved. Feasibility uses the first 32 lexicographically sorted high validation article IDs, disjoint from evaluation articles.
race_middle.metric: Question accuracy over all 1436 middle validation questions, grouped into 368 original articles.
limits: Evaluation uses the public validation split, not the official test split.
Questions from an article are separate decisions; no claim is made that their answers are jointly reasoned.
Feasibility is drawn from the high-school level and differs in difficulty from the middle-school evaluation.

pubmedqa.name: PubMedQA expert-labelled research question answering
pubmedqa.scope: The official 500 test IDs from PQA-L are evaluation; the other 500 labelled items form the feasibility pool. State contains only the original CONTEXTS; the field contains QUESTION. Choices are yes, no and maybe.
pubmedqa.metric: Three-way answer accuracy and macro F1 over the official 500 test questions.
limits: One field per abstract provides no cross-field prefix reuse.
This is abstract-grounded biomedical question answering, not clinical decision-making.
LONG_ANSWER, LABELS, MESHES, auxiliary predictions and final_decision are excluded from model input.

scifact_cited.name: SciFact cited-abstract claim classification
scifact_cited.scope: For each official development claim, classify every originally cited document as SUPPORT, CONTRADICT or NOINFO. Group pairs by original abstract. A cited document has NOINFO when that claim has no annotated evidence in the document. Training claims form the feasibility pool.
scifact_cited.metric: Claim-document pair accuracy and macro F1 over 340 pairs from all 300 development claims and 283 original abstracts.
limits: This supplied-citation classification subtask is not full-corpus retrieval or the official end-to-end SciFact score.
Model input includes the complete title and abstract, never annotated evidence sentence IDs or labels.
Claims with multiple cited documents contribute multiple decisions; report pair counts separately from claim counts.
Training and development can share abstracts; the split unit is the original claim.
